summary: Comprehensive testing of JARVIS AI Assistant app completed. All backend APIs (10/10 tests) and frontend features passed. Chat, conversations, quick actions, TTS, and UI navigation all working correctly with GPT-5.2 integration via Emergent LLM key.

minor.issue: Error responses return 200 OK instead of proper HTTP error codes (400/404/500). Should use FastAPI HTTPException for proper error handling.

react_native_issues.issue: Using deprecated expo-av package. Should migrate to expo-audio and expo-video before SDK 54.
Version mismatch: installed 55.0.14, expected ~19.0.21. Non-critical but should be updated.

action_items: Consider updating error handling in backend to use proper HTTP status codes (400/404/500) instead of returning errors as 200 OK
Plan migration from expo-av to expo-audio/expo-video before SDK 54
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Error responses should use FastAPI HTTPException with proper status codes instead of returning {"error": ...} with 200 OK
Frontend: expo-av is deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54 - plan migration to expo-audio and expo-video
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes - excellent for testing
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded in all queries
React Native components properly used (no HTML elements)
seed_data_creation: Test conversations created during testing. Backend tests create and clean up test data properly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. Backend uses Emergent LLM key for GPT-5.2, Whisper STT, and OpenAI TTS. Frontend is Expo/React Native with tab navigation. No auth required for beta. Public URL: https://jarvis-beta.preview.emergentagent.com. Minor improvements suggested for error handling and package updates, but not blocking.
